title: Armchair with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Chair back -->
  <rect x='22' y='12' width='56' height='42' rx='12' fill='#E06030'/>
  <!-- Chair back inner highlight -->
  <rect x='28' y='18' width='44' height='30' rx='8' fill='#F0794A'/>
  
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <rect x='8' y='38' width='18' height='34' rx='8' fill='#C84020'/>
  <!-- Left arm highlight -->
  <rect x='11' y='42' width='12' height='8' rx='4' fill='#E06030'/>
  
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <rect x='74' y='38' width='18' height='34' rx='8' fill='#C84020'/>
  <!-- Right arm highlight -->
  <rect x='77' y='42' width='12' height='8' rx='4' fill='#E06030'/>
  
  <!-- Seat cushion -->
  <rect x='18' y='52' width='64' height='18' rx='6' fill='#F09060'/>
  
  <!-- Front skirt/base -->
  <rect x='22' y='68' width='56' height='14' rx='6' fill='#C84020'/>
  
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <rect x='24' y='80' width='8' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8B4513'/>
  
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <rect x='68' y='80' width='8' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8B4513'/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on the backrest -->
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='32' r='4' fill='#FFE040'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='32' r='4' fill='#FFE040'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q50 54 62 42' stroke='#FFE040' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='40' r='4' fill='#FF9060' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='40' r='4' fill='#FF9060' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
